title: Amazon Ads Manager Intern - Remote
description:
Internship | 6 months | full-time | Remote


Our goal is to hire you after the internship. If you need to go back to your studies, it's not a fit for us.

As an Amazon Advertising Manager Intern you'll be responsible for bringing more new leads to our brand stores You'll be the driving force of the advertising team, being responsible for the creation and management of new and existing marketing campaigns.


This is an amazing opportunity to come in and work with a very young team - average age 29 - to develop and execute an advertising strategy for increasing the revenue of our brands. You will have the opportunity to learn a lot about advertising, marketing, and the world of startups in general.


Your role will mainly be a PPC function. As we are a small team, you will be exposed to every part of the advertising process and you will have the opportunity to work on a marketing plan from day 1.


Who We Are

Founded by a former Amazon sales manager and two Forbes under 30, Italian Craftory specializes in launching, growing, and managing brands on Amazon, with particular reference to foreign markets, from the United States to Europe. All of your colleagues are foreigners, so it's essential that you have a good command of English.


The company supports selected partner companies in growing on e-marketplace channels: our clients include both large companies, such as listed companies and already established brands, as well as small and medium enterprises, which we help transform products into Amazon best-sellers in just a few months.


We have active projects in over 7 countries worldwide and are now aiming to expand our client base, particularly of Italian companies, which we believe still have a lot of potential in terms of internationalization.


What Will You Do


  • Set up and manage ad campaigns on Amazon, continuously optimizing product listings for best practices, conversion, and increased return: pictures, copywriting, keyword, title, bullet points, A+ Content, product descriptions, Storefront, and so on;
  • Develop strategies to improve the organic ranking of our products, including continuous keyword and competitors research, identifying targets and opportunities to grow sales for our brands;
  • Manage Bid Prices, Cost per Conversion, Cost per Click, and product promotions for new product releases and events, optimizing PPC campaigns to achieve sales and margin goal;
  • Monitor ad performance across multiple brands. Understanding why ads perform as they do, and making adjustments to maximize successful campaigns and cutting or modifying unsuccessful campaigns;
  • Prepare monthly meeting notes to review marketing and advertising performance, tracking KPIs and pinpointing issues, to plan goals for the succeeding months;
  • Maintain accuracy, integrity, and quality of Product Detail Pages and listing, occasionally resolving issues with Amazon Seller and Vendor Support;
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Finance team on campaigns and promotions to support go-to-market strategies, and presenting budgets and capital requirements to execute campaigns;
  • Be dedicated to self-improvement by reading, listening to, or watching material related to Amazon PPC, and the ability to describe new strategies to the team and implement those strategies.


What will you learn


  • How to develop effective paid search strategies, launching and optimizing various PPC campaigns;
  • How to do keyword research and selection, competitor research, campaign builds, and audience targeting;
  • How to analyze online search volumes and the growth trend for certain keywords of interest;
  • How to navigate the Amazon Advertising ecosystem, learning about Amazon Marketing and Brand Analytics, the types of ads and how they work, Amazon Seller and Vendor Central;
  • How to create highly segmented campaigns across all ad types, acquiring knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display and strategies within each;
  • How to figure out which marketing metrics to aim for (e.g. ACoS, ad spend) based on the company’s business strategy;
  • How to use analytics tools to analyze, interpret and visualize data to maintain ACOS, grow ad spend sales, and company metrics;
  • How to monitor and produce budget reports and bids to gain better ROI;
  • How to define an advertising strategy for all stages from ideation to marketplace listing, including a go-to-market strategy in collaboration with marketing and finance teams.


What Italian Craftory can offer you


  • Paid Internship + opportunity to work remotely from your sofa or from your beach house
  • The unique opportunity to contribute to the international development of a young pet lifestyle brand for new generations.


This is an ideal position if you are a recent graduate or a final year student, you have a significant interest in working in startups and you are interested in learning more about advertising, marketing and e-commerce.


What We Are Like to Work With

title: Internship - Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.


Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!


Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;


Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);
  • At least 1 year of experience with PV inverters;
  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Knowledge about Brazilian regulation on PV;
  • MS Office.


Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • English speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.


Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

title: AI Engineer (NLP)
description:
We're looking for a Senior ML/AI Engineer to own and evolve our LLM-powered user experience. You'll work directly with our technical co-founder to build, optimize, and monitor agent systems that parse workout descriptions, provide scaling recommendations, and enable conversational data retrieval - all with production-grade accuracy and speed.

This is a hands-on role focused on the ML/AI engineering side: prompt engineering, model optimization, agent orchestration, and continuous improvement based on real-world usage patterns.

What You’ll Do

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the workout parsing system: improve accuracy of our fine-tuned model (currently Qwen-based) that converts natural language workout descriptions into structured schemas
  • Design and implement agent workflows for workout scaling recommendations and performance tracking
  • Build observability workflows using Langfuse to identify and systematically address model performance issues
  • Optimize agent response latency while maintaining accuracy across our tool-based reasoning system
  • Collaborate on agent architecture decisions, including potential migration to frameworks like DSPy
  • Ship production features: workout entry system, scaling recommendations, and score reporting

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of ML/AI engineering experience with at least 2 years working with LLMs in production
  • Strong prompt engineering and model optimization skills
  • Experience building and deploying agent systems with tools/functions
  • Proven ability to use observability platforms to diagnose and improve model performance
  • Experience with model fine-tuning (any framework/approach)
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Active CrossFit participant - candidates should understand standard movements and workout structures

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (DSPy, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Background in production ML operations and monitoring
  • Experience with Modal.com or similar serverless ML platforms
  • Track record of iteratively improving LLM systems based on user feedback and metrics
  • Experience fine tuning similar open-source LLMs

Success in First 6 Months

  • Ship workout entry system with improved parsing accuracy
  • Launch basic workout scaling recommendations
  • Implement user score reporting and retrieval
  • Establish robust monitoring workflows to catch and address model failures and poor user experiences
  • Contribute to agent architecture decisions as we scale

You'll work directly with our technical co-founder to build, optimize, and monitor agent systems that parse workout descriptions, provide scaling recommendations, and enable conversational data retrieval - all with production-grade accuracy and speed.

This is a hands-on role focused on the ML/AI engineering side: prompt engineering, model optimization, agent orchestration, and continuous improvement based on real-world usage patterns.

What You’ll Do

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the workout parsing system: improve accuracy of our fine-tuned model (currently Qwen-based) that converts natural language workout descriptions into structured schemas
  • Design and implement agent workflows for workout scaling recommendations and performance tracking
  • Build observability workflows using Langfuse to identify and systematically address model performance issues
  • Optimize agent response latency while maintaining accuracy across our tool-based reasoning system
  • Collaborate on agent architecture decisions, including potential migration to frameworks like DSPy
  • Ship production features: workout entry system, scaling recommendations, and score reporting

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of ML/AI engineering experience with at least 2 years working with LLMs in production
  • Strong prompt engineering and model optimization skills
  • Experience building and deploying agent systems with tools/functions
  • Proven ability to use observability platforms to diagnose and improve model performance
  • Experience with model fine-tuning (any framework/approach)
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Active CrossFit participant - candidates should understand standard movements and workout structures

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (DSPy, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Background in production ML operations and monitoring
  • Experience with Modal.com or similar serverless ML platforms
  • Track record of iteratively improving LLM systems based on user feedback and metrics
  • Experience fine tuning similar open-source LLMs

Success in First 6 Months

  • Ship workout entry system with improved parsing accuracy
  • Launch basic workout scaling recommendations
  • Implement user score reporting and retrieval
  • Establish robust monitoring workflows to catch and address model failures and poor user experiences
  • Contribute to agent architecture decisions as we scale

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Job Hunter (Parceria Part-time)
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Job Hunter parceiro(a) para atuar junto à Handz , focando em conectar nossa base qualificada de profissionais às melhores oportunidades do mercado.

Nesta parceria, você será braço estratégico dos nossos assessorados. Se você tem um networking aquecido, conhece os atalhos do mercado de recrutamento e busca uma atuação flexível com foco total em resultados (sucess-fee), esta é a oportunidade ideal. Sua missão será encurtar a distância entre o talento e a vaga, garantindo que nossos clientes cheguem às mesas de decisão das empresas mais desejadas.


Como funcionará a parceria

  • Modelo: Part-time / Freelance (Flexibilidade total de horários).
  • Remuneração: Baseada em Success Fee (comissão por cada recolocação concretizada através da sua atuação).
  • Foco: Mapeamento de oportunidades ocultas, abertura de portas com decision-makers e indicação ativa de candidatos da nossa base.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Prospecção de Oportunidades: Identificar vagas (abertas ou ocultas) que se conectem com o perfil dos nossos profissionais assessorados.
  • Hunting Ativo: Utilizar LinkedIn Recruiter, redes de relacionamento e ferramentas de mercado para localizar os hiring managers das empresas-alvo.
  • Abertura de Portas: Realizar a abordagem estratégica e a apresentação dos perfis da base Handz para as lideranças das empresas e consultorias de RH.
  • Market Intelligence: Monitorar tendências de contratação em verticais específicas para antecipar movimentos de mercado.
  • Alinhamento de Perfil: Garantir que as oportunidades encontradas estejam em sinergia com o momento de carreira e pretensão salarial de cada assessorado.

Sua missão será encurtar a distância entre o talento e a vaga, garantindo que nossos clientes cheguem às mesas de decisão das empresas mais desejadas.


Como funcionará a parceria

  • Modelo: Part-time / Freelance (Flexibilidade total de horários).
  • Remuneração: Baseada em Success Fee (comissão por cada recolocação concretizada através da sua atuação).
  • Foco: Mapeamento de oportunidades ocultas, abertura de portas com decision-makers e indicação ativa de candidatos da nossa base.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Prospecção de Oportunidades: Identificar vagas (abertas ou ocultas) que se conectem com o perfil dos nossos profissionais assessorados.
  • Hunting Ativo: Utilizar LinkedIn Recruiter, redes de relacionamento e ferramentas de mercado para localizar os hiring managers das empresas-alvo.
  • Abertura de Portas: Realizar a abordagem estratégica e a apresentação dos perfis da base Handz para as lideranças das empresas e consultorias de RH.
  • Market Intelligence: Monitorar tendências de contratação em verticais específicas para antecipar movimentos de mercado.
  • Alinhamento de Perfil: Garantir que as oportunidades encontradas estejam em sinergia com o momento de carreira e pretensão salarial de cada assessorado.

description:
Descrição da Empresa A Roar Centro de Terapias Especializadas é uma clínica voltada para o atendimento de pacientes neurodivergentes e o acolhimento das famílias com muito amor e respeito!

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um(a) Secretário(a) para desempenhar um cargo essencial na organização das atividades administrativas no Roar Centro de Terapias Especializadas. As responsabilidades diárias incluem o suporte às demandas administrativas do centro, organização de documentos, agendamento de consultas, autorização de guias de planos de saúde, relacionamento com as operadoras de plano de saúde, atendimento a clientes e suporte à equipe de gestão. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e exige presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades Administrativas e Organizacionais: Experiência com agendamento de consultas, autorização de guias de plano de saúde, atendimento humanizado, organização de documentos e arquivos, e suporte administrativo geral.
  • Comunicação: Capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita clara, essencial para lidar com clientes e demais colaboradores.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Foco em oferecer um atendimento ao cliente acolhedor, eficiente e profissional para garantir a satisfação dos clientes.
  • Qualificações adicionais, como formação em Administração, Secretariado ou áreas relacionadas, e habilidades em informática, serão consideradas um diferencial.

title: Hiring: Portuguese Language Dubbing Artist
description:
Company Description

Sukudo Studios is Asia's leading provider of localization services for the media and entertainment sector. Renowned for partnering with globally recognized entertainment studios and streaming platforms, Sukudo Studios offers a comprehensive range of services, including dubbing, subtitling, accessibility, media management, and content transformation in over 50 languages. With years of industry expertise and cutting-edge facilities, the company ensures a seamless blend of creative and technical excellence. Sukudo Studios is committed to making content accessible worldwide while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Visit sukudostudios.com for more information and updates.


Role Description

  • Strong professional proficiency in Portuguese
  • Prior experience in drama dubbing and/or voice-over performance.
  • Strong understanding of emotion, tone, lip-sync timing, and cultural adaptation.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality, natural-sounding voice performance aligned with character and context.
  • Experience in similar localization and dubbing projects is preferred.


Qualifications

  • Excellent command of Portuguese pronunciation, fluency, and expressive delivery (emotion, pacing, intensity).
  • Proven experience in voice acting, dubbing, or narration for films/series/short-form content.
  • Ability to follow direction and maintain character consistency across episodes/scenes.
  • Familiarity with audio recording processes and basic knowledge of audio editing tools is a plus.
  • Strong professionalism: ability to meet deadlines, take feedback, and collaborate with creative/project teams.
  • Prior exposure to localization workflows or media/entertainment industry projects is advantageous.
  • Degree or certification in Languages, Communication, Performing Arts, or related fields is preferred but not mandatory.

Easy apply on LinkedIn

title: International Group Holding – “Controller with CFO Track”
description:
Company Description

Home Alliance is a trusted on-demand resource for homeowners looking for local, reliable technicians. With a seamless booking process that takes less than a minute, customers can expect a confirmation within an hour and on-time service delivery. The company ensures quality by working exclusively with verified, experienced, licensed, and insured professionals, providing peace of mind for all home repair and maintenance needs.


About the Group

We are a diversified international holding company with operating businesses across multiple geographies and industries. As the group enters its next phase of growth and capital structuring, we are seeking a high-caliber Financial Controller with the ambition and capability to evolve into a Chief Financial Officer role.


The Role

This is a senior finance leadership position with full responsibility for group-level financial control, reporting, and governance. You will work closely with the CFO and Board, gaining exposure to strategic finance, M&A, funding, and long-term value creation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead group financial reporting, consolidation, and statutory compliance across multiple entities
  • Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes
  • Design and strengthen internal controls, policies, and governance frameworks
  • Partner with operating company finance leads and senior management
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow planning at group level
  • Participate in M&A, due diligence, and post-acquisition integration
  • Act as a key deputy to the CFO with increasing strategic responsibility


Ideal Profile

  • 8–12+ years of progressive finance experience, including group consolidation
  • Strong background in IFRS (or USA GAAP with IFRS exposure)
  • Experience in a holding company, PE-backed group, or multi-entity environment
  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent)
  • Leadership mindset with clear ambition to step into a CFO role within 2–4 years

title: PE Deal Origination Associate
description:
Caprae Capital Partners


Caprae Capital Partners is a next-generation private equity and venture platform built by operators, not career financiers. Led by founder Kevin Hong , a serial tech entrepreneur who has scaled companies to $31M ARR and $7M in revenue , Caprae was formed alongside fellow entrepreneurs who have achieved eight-figure and nine-figure exits (including acquisitions by Twitter and Square ). The broader partner network includes a former NASA software engineer and a former Chief of Staff at Google, a team engineered for innovation and disruption.


Since launching in 2025, Caprae has already closed over $50M in transaction value , with $80M+ across its ecosystem , and an additional $60M scheduled to close by Q1 2026 . The company has been growing 20%+ MoM for 12 months, and this trend is expected to continue for the next several months.


Caprae is rethinking how entrepreneurship, capital, and talent connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move aggressively. This is not a traditional finance firm.


Caprae is redefining how entrepreneurship and capital connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move fast.


Role Description


We’re looking for a PE Deal Origination Associate with a sharp mind, strong communication skills, and the drive to turn conversations into real deals.


This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed
  • Absurd upside on deal closes for top performers
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to output and conversion
  • Fast-track growth into Manager, leadership, or platform roles within Caprae

Since launching in 2025, Caprae has already closed over $50M in transaction value , with $80M+ across its ecosystem , and an additional $60M scheduled to close by Q1 2026 . The company has been growing 20%+ MoM for 12 months, and this trend is expected to continue for the next several months.


Caprae is rethinking how entrepreneurship, capital, and talent connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move aggressively. This is not a traditional finance firm.


Caprae is redefining how entrepreneurship and capital connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move fast.


Role Description


We’re looking for a PE Deal Origination Associate with a sharp mind, strong communication skills, and the drive to turn conversations into real deals.


This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed
  • Absurd upside on deal closes for top performers
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to output and conversion
  • Fast-track growth into Manager, leadership, or platform roles within Caprae

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
Position: Network Operations Center Engineer

Location: LATAM (Ideally Brazil, Argentina, Mexico)

Type: Contract

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor systems and applications to ensure availability and performance.
  • Identify and respond to incidents, escalating issues to the appropriate teams.
  • Use monitoring tools like Datadog and New Relic to detect and manage issues.
  • Communicate clearly during incidents and work closely with multiple teams.
  • Make quick, effective decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Share real examples of incidents you’ve managed and how you resolved them.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience working as a NOC Engineer or in a production support role.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (Datadog, New Relic).
  • Hands-on incident detection and management experience.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to stay calm and effective during critical incidents.
  • Comfortable discussing real-world incident scenarios during interviews.

title: Data Scientist  [Computer Vision] - [Banco de Talentos]
description:
Estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais de Data Science com especialização em Computação Visual .

O objetivo é identificar talentos para futuras oportunidades voltadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes baseadas em dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Projetar, desenvolver e implementar modelos e pipelines de visão computacional e machine learning;

Construir e treinar modelos para classificação, segmentação e detecção de objetos;

Realizar pré-processamento, manipulação e engenharia de features em dados de imagem e vídeo;

Automatizar fluxos de análise de mídia e extração de informações;

Integrar soluções com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Hugging Face, Anthropic etc.);

Aplicar boas práticas de código limpo, versionamento e engenharia de software;

Realizar deploy e experimentação de modelos em ambiente AWS;

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar soluções aplicáveis e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

Conhecimento avançado em Python;

Experiência com bibliotecas de visão computacional: OpenCV, Pillow, scikit-image;

Experiência com frameworks de machine learning e deep learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn;

Experiência em treinamento e ajuste de modelos para imagens e vídeos;

Conhecimento em integração com APIs de LLMs: OpenAI, Hugging Face, Anthropic etc;

Manipulação e pré-processamento de dados;

Experiência em Versionamento com Git;

Boas práticas de código (Clean Code);

Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP );

Desejáveis: Experiência com GIS (Geoprocessamento / Spatial Data).

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Sênior (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software, de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Backend.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, transformando requisitos em software robusto, seguro e escalável, alinhado às necessidades do negócio;
  • Atuar na análise e evolução da arquitetura de software, assegurando organização, consistência, performance e eficiência de seus componentes;
  • Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes automatizados, versionamento, revisões de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Detalhar requisitos técnicos complexos em colaboração com clientes e áreas envolvidas, traduzindo demandas de negócio em soluções viáveis;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;
  • Participar de discussões táticas e operacionais, contribuindo na definição de metas anuais, estudos de viabilidade técnica e escolhas estratégicas de tecnologia;
  • Orientar, capacitar e apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio, arquitetura e design, promovendo disseminação de conhecimento e boas práticas;
  • Criar frameworks, componentes reutilizáveis e padrões técnicos quando necessário para acelerar e qualificar o desenvolvimento;
  • Definir, revisar e aprimorar processos de engenharia que suportem os objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área de atuação;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Contribuir em fóruns e discussões sobre inovação e tendências de mercado, disseminando conhecimento e fortalecendo a cultura de aprendizado constante;
  • Atuar diretamente na resolução de incidentes, investigando causas raiz e implementando melhorias que aumentem a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da plataforma;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE);

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL e MongoDB – Nível avançado;

● Arquitetura de Software (cloudnative, web, microsserviços);

● DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar);

● Sistemas Distribuídos, Escalabilidade, Resiliência (nível intermediário);

● Mensageria (RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub ou equivalente);

● NoSQL (Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente);

● Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage ou equivalente);

● Processamento distribuído (Hadoop, Spark);

● Pipelines de dados/streaming (Apache Beam, Dataflow, Airflow);

● Processamento assíncrono (Celery, Temporal IO);

● MCP;

● Copilot ou equivalente;

● Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes);

● Design Patterns;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros);

● Observabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações em produção (logs estruturados,

métricas, traces).

title: MARINHEIRO DE MÁQUINAS - OILER (III/4 ou III/5)
description:
MISC MARINE DO BRAZIL está buscando MARINHEIRO DE MÁQUINAS (III/4 ou III/5) para integrar sua frota no Brasil.


Nossa frota é composta por navios modernos e altamente tecnológicos, projetados para oferecer o máximo em conforto e segurança. Equipados com academia, sala de cinema, cadeiras de massagem e sistemas de posicionamento dinâmico (DP) Kongsberg, fabricados por gigantes como Samsung e Hyundai, nossos navios representam o que há de mais avançado em eficiência operacional na indústria marítima.


Requisitos Mandatórios:


  • Certificações STCW válidas para a posição
  • CIR
  • EBPQ
  • TBS1
  • EBCP
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Experiência prévia em navios-tanque


Informações Adicionais:


  • Certificado de Vacinação contra COVID-19 e Febre amarela
  • Passaporte Válido
  • Escala de trabalho: 42x 42
  • Ambiente de tripulação mista
  • Salário competitivo


Benefícios:


  • Vale-alimentação CAJU benefícios
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco Top Nacional (extensivo aos familiares sem custo e sem coparticipação)
  • Plano dental Metlife Diamond (extensivo aos familiares sem custo e sem coparticipação)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Gym Pass
  • Ajuda de custo mensal fixa


Observação: Essas posições são exclusivamente destinadas a marítimos (as) brasileiros (as) com certificação STCW válida, com disponibilidade de embarque em Navio DPST, com escala de 42x42.

title: Assistente de Recursos Humanos - PCD
description:
Se você deseja construir uma carreira em Recursos Humanos em um ambiente acolhedor, inclusivo e repleto de oportunidades de aprendizado, esta é a sua chance! Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Recursos Humanos (PCD) para atuar de forma colaborativa e contribuir diretamente para a experiência dos nossos colaboradores e para o fortalecimento da nossa cultura organizacional.


Quem somos e o que acreditamos

Somos uma empresa que valoriza relações humanas, transparência e crescimento contínuo. Trabalhamos diariamente para criar um ambiente que respeita as individualidades, apoia o desenvolvimento de cada pessoa e incentiva o aprendizado constante. Aqui, acreditamos que todos têm um papel fundamental na construção de uma cultura forte, plural e colaborativa.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor, com foco no bem-estar;
  • Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;
  • Oportunidades reais de aprendizado e desenvolvimento;
  • Cultura voltada ao trabalho em equipe, respeito e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Acesso a projetos, ferramentas e práticas modernas de RH.


Suas responsabilidades

Como Assistente de Recursos Humanos, você dará suporte às rotinas essenciais da área, contribuindo para uma operação organizada e centrada nas pessoas. Entre suas atividades, estão:


  • Apoio nos processos de recrutamento e seleção, incluindo triagem, agendamento de entrevistas e envio de feedback;
  • Suporte na organização de treinamentos, ações de desenvolvimento e capacitação;
  • Apoio às iniciativas de comunicação interna;
  • Auxílio nas rotinas de admissão, rescisão e manutenção de contratos;
  • Organização de arquivos, documentos e informações relacionadas a RH;
  • Atendimento aos colaboradores, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre políticas e procedimentos;
  • Participação em projetos internos de clima, engajamento e comunicação.

title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior React Native Developer
description:
Salary Open to negotitate based on experience, Competitive! (payment in USD)

(Full time position, independent contractor.)


StaffingAbroad is seeking a highly skilled Frontend Developer to join one of the #1 Fintech & Crypto companies in the United States . This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and build world-class applications in a dynamic, innovative environment.

This position is offered as a 100% remote role.


About the Role

As a Frontend Developer, your primary skillset will be React Native , with additional strong experience in React being highly desirable. You’ll play a critical role in designing and delivering highly polished, pixel-perfect applications that provide exceptional user experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and backend developers, to bring complex financial and crypto-related solutions to life.


What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software design, or related field of study, or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years' experience building production-grade web or mobile applications with a strong focus on UI excellence.
  • English C1 (MUST)
  • Deep expertise with React Native (primary skill).
  • Strong experience with React (highly desirable), including hooks, context, and performance optimization.
  • Strong TypeScript experience.
  • Expert-level CSS skills with proficiency in Tailwind and styled-components .
  • Proven track record of delivering pixel-perfect, highly polished user interfaces .
  • Experience building and maintaining reusable component libraries .
  • Experience with complex form implementations and client-state management .
  • Solid foundation in software development best practices.
  • Familiarity with software quality practices such as unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and code coverage.
  • Experience using source control (Git) .
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies .
  • Bilingual English (conversational level required) .
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and alignment with company culture and values.

Plus

  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) pipelines (TeamCity, Azure DevOps).


Why Join?

  • 100% Remote –
  • Join a team that is shaping the future of #1 Fintech and Crypto in the U.S.

title: Digital Experience Engineer (Nexthink)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). title: Data Scientist  [Modelos Clássicos] - [Banco de Talentos]
description:
Estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais de Data Science com especialização em Métodos Clássicos .

O objetivo é identificar talentos para futuras oportunidades voltadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes baseadas em dados não estruturados e IA generativa, apoiando desafios estratégicos da organização.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver soluções preditivas utilizando métodos clássicos de machine learning , incluindo: Regressão (linear e logística), classificação modelos de séries temporais, arvores de decisão, gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e KNN;

Conduzir análises exploratórias completas (EDA), identificando padrões, inconsistências e oportunidades de transformação dos dados;

Executar pré-processamento avançado: limpeza, normalização, encoding, tratamento de outliers e balanceamento;

Selecionar e construir variáveis relevantes (feature engineering), aplicando técnicas estatísticas e conhecimento de negócio;

Implementar modelos preditivos com foco em performance, interpretabilidade e impacto estratégico;

Validar modelos utilizando métricas adequadas, técnicas de cross-validation e tuning de hiperparâmetros;

Atuar diretamente com o cliente, participando de discussões de backlog, refinamento de requisitos e proposição de melhorias técnicas e de processo;

Documentar análises, decisões técnicas e resultados de forma clara e estruturada.



Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência prática com Python aplicado a ciência de dados e machine learning;

Experiência com métodos clássicos de machine learning;

Vivência com Databricks ;

Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP);

Domínio de técnicas de validação de modelos, tuning de hiperparâmetros e métricas de avaliação (AUC, F1, RMSE, MAPE etc.).

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details

title: Doc Sign
description:
Hiring for DocuSign CLM Consultant | Remote | Long Term Contract


Hi,

Please find the below Job Opportunity.

Title: DocuSign CLM Consultant

Length of Assignment : 12 months Contract

Location: Remote

Client: Oxford/Alcoa client

Open to Candidates In: United States and Brazil

Time Zone: Primarily EST; may also support BRT (±1 hour)

Language: English required; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

Role Overview

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain DocuSign CLM workflows , including fixes and new implementations
  • Provide global user support , responding to support cases and assisting end users
  • Perform governance activities , including workflow failure analysis and access reviews
  • Collaborate with and provide knowledge sharing among other CLM administrators

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

title: Google Cloud Engagement Manager
description:
PAN-

$6100 Monthly

6 months+ expected to go longer

Brazil Remote (LATAM)


Engagement manager who has extensive 5-10 years experience selling, customer adoption Google Cloud/GCP.


This position is responsible for providing leadership, management and strategy for the sell with/go-to-market engagement and all joint activities with GCP. The Engagement manager will have a myriad of different responsibilities to ensure leverage and consistent engagement with GCP to drive customer engagements, qualified pipeline and cloud bookings that meet and exceed quota and expectations. The Engagement Manager will be part of the team that coordinates *** sales activities and will be a central conduit for engagement management between the Palo Alto Network’s sales organization and GCP. He will report to the director for Service Providers but will have several dotted line coordination requirements for consistent communication and engagement with Business Development, Marketing, Channels, Inside Sales and Product Marketing/Development. This position will be knowledge expert on all aspects of GCP and will be asked to present at QBRs, executive meetings, training and events.

The GCP Engagement Manager is regarded to be highly strategic to the company and the Public Cloud initiative in regards to strategy, influence and execution. The Engagement manager is required to contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Public Cloud strategy outside of their day to day activities and will be called upon for their subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities. It is expected that he chases consistent interaction and engagement with customers, strategic vendors, channel partners and other third parties in support of the “sell with” activities with GCP. The Engagement manager will demonstrate a deep understanding of GCP go-to-market strategies including but not limited to co-selling, strategic planning and goal setting, channel programs, marketing campaigns and programs, strategic events and funnel management.

Manage joint sell with and go to market activities with GCP

Track all opportunities, pipeline and bookings and provide forecasts and funnel management reports

Facilitate co-selling opportunities, account mapping and other sales engagements between Palo Alto Network’s field sales and the GCP sales teams

Support Palo Alto Network’s field sales organization on engagement management with GCP.

Assist with providing content for Google Cloud training curriculum and sales enablement

Coordinate activities and have involvement with the Public Cloud virtual team of Business Development, Marketing, Product Management, Channels and Sales as part of cloud strategy

Develop annual strategic plan and performance goals for assigned GCPr

Provide support and coordination for channel activity with assigned Cloud Provider

Understand and articulate Google Cloud strategic initiatives and gain a deep understanding of the activities, roadmap and vision of the Cloud Provider

Provide an escalation point for pre-sales and post sales issues for any activity with the GCP

Build and maintain relationships with key personnel in GCP to solidify Palo Alto Network’s standing and awareness within the provider and to assist in the development of key relationships with the extended Palo Alto Network’s cloud team and executives

Direct engagement and partner relationships are a critical part of this role

Help provide insight in the support of Google Cloud events and attend/participate in the events

Provide support in the form of expertise and training for Palo Alto Network’s field sales enablement


YOUR EXPERIENCE

BA, BS (or equivalent work experience), MBA preferred

5+ Years’ experience in Sales – Account or Channel Management

Public Cloud experience preferred

Channel experience including selling with or managing channel partners is preferred

Channel Program experience is a plus

Demonstrated history of managing quota bearing sales or channel teams

Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of Palo Alto Network’s roadmap and technology development efforts.

The role calls for knowledge of competitive security products.

Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to PAN’s customer base, and maintains a general understanding of competitive selling strategies.

Demonstrated ability to work in a virtual and matrix environment

25% Travel with ability to travel internationally

Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

\"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to do whatever necessary to assist in winning business

Coordinate activities and have involvement with the Public Cloud virtual team of Business Development, Marketing, Product Management, Channels and Sales as part of cloud strategy

Develop annual strategic plan and performance goals for assigned GCPr

Provide support and coordination for channel activity with assigned Cloud Provider

BA, BS (or equivalent work experience), MBA preferred

title: Fechador
description:
Estamos contratando: Closer de Vendas | GMT Comércio de Ferramentas

A GMT Comércio de Ferramentas atua no fornecimento de materiais metálicos e ferramentas para indústria, construção e manutenção. Trabalhamos com clientes de médio e grande porte, com ticket médio acima de R$ 50.000.

Buscamos um(a) Closer experiente para conduzir negociações de alto valor com tomadores de decisão em indústrias, construtoras e distribuidores.

Sua rotina:

  • Conduzir negociações comerciais por telefone e videochamada com clientes B2B de ticket elevado (R$ 50k+)
  • Aplicar o método SPIN Selling para identificar dores, implicações e construir propostas de valor sob medida
  • Realizar alto volume de ligações estratégicas — aqui o telefone é a principal arma
  • Elaborar e negociar propostas comerciais de materiais metálicos e ferramentas
  • Fazer follow-ups consistentes e gerenciar pipeline no CRM
  • Desenvolver relacionamento de longo prazo com carteira de clientes ativos e novos

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida com vendas B2B por telefone (mínimo 1 ano)
  • Domínio do método SPIN Selling ou metodologias de venda consultiva similares
  • Perfil agressivo comercialmente — gostar de ligar, negociar e fechar
  • Habilidade para lidar com ciclos de venda mais longos e valores altos
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas negociações simultaneamente
  • Boa comunicação verbal — clareza, objetividade e poder de persuasão

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com venda de materiais metálicos, ferramentas, insumos industriais ou materiais de construção
  • Conhecimento técnico de produtos metalúrgicos (aços, tubos, chapas, conexões, etc.)
  • Vivência com vendas para indústria, construtoras ou distribuidores
  • Histórico comprovado de fechamento em tickets acima de R$ 30k

Remuneração e benefícios:

  • Salário fixo: R$ 3.000 + ajuda de custo
  • Comissão agressiva sobre fechamentos (OTE)
  • Média esperada de ganhos: R$ 8.000/mês (ajuda de custo + comissão)
  • Sem teto de comissão — quanto mais vende, mais ganha
  • Treinamento sobre nosso portfólio de produtos e processos comerciais

title: Executivo de Vendas B2B
description:
Estamos em expansão e buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas B2B com experiência sólida em vendas em empresas de consultoria , para fortalecer nossa geração de oportunidades e acelerar o crescimento comercial.


Sobre o desafio:

Seu principal foco será prospecção ativa e qualificação de oportunidades B2B , identificando empresas com potencial, entendendo suas dores e conectando essas necessidades às soluções da QualityMap.

Buscamos alguém com perfil hunter, que saiba abrir mercado, construir relacionamento inicial e gerar oportunidades reais de negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes B2B (outbound e inbound)
  • Mapear empresas-alvo e decisores estratégicos
  • Realizar contatos iniciais (cold call, e-mail, LinkedIn, networking)
  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico para entender desafios e necessidades dos clientes
  • Qualificar leads e oportunidades (perfil, necessidade, budget, timing)
  • Organizar e nutrir pipeline de oportunidades no CRM
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a área estratégica para evolução das oportunidades
  • Representar a QualityMap em contatos comerciais e networking quando necessário


✅ Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em vendas B2B em empresas de consultoria
  • Forte vivência em prospecção ativa
  • Experiência em qualificação de leads e oportunidades comerciais
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento
  • Capacidade de entender necessidades de negócio dos clientes
  • Organização de pipeline e uso de CRM
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado a metas


Diferenciais:

  • Networking ativo no mercado B2B
  • Experiência em consultorias de tecnologia


Modelo de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado

100% remoto

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Freelance UGC Creator (Paid Social) - Personal Finance / Loans (Meta Reels + Stories)
description:
We’re producing a UGC ad pack for a US finance brand to run on paid social. We’re hiring 3 different on‑camera creators (to avoid “same‑face fatigue”). Each creator will deliver 3-4 short, vertical UGC ads that feel authentic, credible, and policy-safe for the finance/credit category .

This is NOT an AI-avatar project. We need real on-camera creators who can speak clearly, act naturally, and deliver high-quality footage on time.

Platform: Meta placements (Reels / Stories / Feed)

Format: UGC-style vertical video ads (talk-to-camera + simple b-roll + optional greenscreen/pointing)


What the brand is about (context you’ll speak to)

This brand’s mission is to expand affordable credit access to working Americans . Their personal loans consider employment information (not only credit history), and repayment is designed to be simpler via payroll/direct deposit . The tone we want: trustworthy, transparent, helpful-never hypey .


Deliverables (per creator)

You’ll create 3-4 UGC-style vertical video ads , each:

  • 9:16 (1080×1920), MP4
  • 15-30 seconds (mostly 15s; some 30s “explainer” style)
  • Strong hook in the first 1-2 seconds
  • Clear CTA at the end (we provide CTA options)
  • Shot in UGC style: selfie/talk-to-camera, simple b‑roll, greenscreen/pointing where helpful
  • Burned-in captions (ad-ready)

Also required:

  • Raw clips (so we can cut new hook variants later)
  • 1-2 alternate hooks per script
  • Up to 2 revision rounds , with 48-hour turnaround on revision requests


What we provide
  • Creative brief + angles (trust/transparency, employment-based approval positioning, payroll/direct deposit repayment, “how it works”)
  • Scripts OR script templates (if you prefer writing your own, that’s a big plus)
  • Finance compliance “Do/Don’t” language + required disclosures/end card guidance
  • Brand assets (logos, examples, references)


The style we’re looking for
  • Confident, friendly, conversational (not “salesy”)
  • Can play simple roles: “working professional,” “friend sharing a tip,” “quick explainer”
  • Comfortable delivering lines about financial products carefully and responsibly
  • Strong pacing + clear pronunciation for a US audience
  • Can also do a more “official explainer” vibe when needed (clean framing, confident delivery)


Requirements (please apply only if you can confirm)
  • Fluent English on camera with clear audio (US audience)
  • Comfortable taking direction and following a brief
  • Familiar with personal finance basics (loans/APR/repayment concepts)
  • Can deliver 3-4 videos within 5-7 days of receiving scripts
  • Can handle revisions fast (within 48 hours , max 2 rounds)
  • You are a real person on camera (no AI avatars, no synthetic face/voice)


Compensation

$150-$200 USD (fixed) per creator for 3-4 videos , including revisions.

If this first pack goes well, there’s potential for ongoing content.


Timeline


  • Start ASAP after selection
  • First drafts: typically 5-7 days after scripts are received
  • Revisions: within 48 hours
  • Target: first project completion by February 28, 2026


Usage rights


By applying, you agree that if selected, we can use your videos for:

  • Paid ads + organic social
  • Editing/cropping/adding overlays

Worldwide usage across placements

  • No posting required on your personal accounts (content creation only).

  • Confident, friendly, conversational (not “salesy”)
  • Can play simple roles: “working professional,” “friend sharing a tip,” “quick explainer”
  • Comfortable delivering lines about financial products carefully and responsibly
  • Strong pacing + clear pronunciation for a US audience
  • Can also do a more “official explainer” vibe when needed (clean framing, confident delivery)

  • Fluent English on camera with clear audio (US audience)
  • Comfortable taking direction and following a brief
  • Familiar with personal finance basics (loans/APR/repayment concepts)
  • Can deliver 3-4 videos within 5-7 days of receiving scripts
  • Can handle revisions fast (within 48 hours , max 2 rounds)

  • First drafts: typically 5-7 days after scripts are received
  • Revisions: within 48 hours

By applying, you agree that if selected, we can use your videos for:

  • Paid ads + organic social
  • Editing/cropping/adding overlays

Worldwide usage across placements

  • No posting required on your personal accounts (content creation only).

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a functional expert in Workday Business Processes , understanding end-to-end process flows.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.


Business Process Expertise (Critical):

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.


Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.


Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.


Stakeholder Interaction:

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

20% interaction with VP-level stakeholders on escalations and high-visibility initiatives.

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.


Immediate Focus (First Months):

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.


Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Workday Prism / X10 (nice-to-have, not mandatory)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.


Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.

title: ENGENHEIRO DE IA PLENO
description:
Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções de inteligência artificial, com criação de agentes e modelo de RAG;
  • Atuar na estruturação de uma arquitetura sistêmica e de dados que potencialize a utilização dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Prover insights sobre formas de melhorias de processos e visões atuais dos projetos já em andamento;
  • Sugerir aplicação de modelos estatísticos e outras formas de refinamento e objetivação dos resultados;
  • Otimizar modelos de IA buscando aprimoramento de desempenho e aumento de eficiência;
  • Garantir os desdobramentos das estratégias de negócios em execução tático-operacional e identificar visões sobre os negócios a partir de cruzamento de dados gerando novos insights;


Requisitos e qualificações:

Conhecimento em:

  • Python;
  • Streamlit;
  • Snowflake;
  • Databricks;
  • Chatbot;
  • IA - criação de agentes/RAG.


Horário de Atuação

  • 9h às 18h - seg a sex - home office


OBS.: Hey! Caso você não preencha todos os requisitos da vaga, te convidamos a se candidatar mesmo assim, ok? Faremos uma análise cuidadosa do seu perfil considerando todas as suas qualificações

title: Investment Banking / Finance Professional — AI Research
description:
We are seeking experienced finance professionals to contribute to frontier AI research focused on advanced financial analysis, modeling, and decision-making systems.


Why Apply

  • Competitive Pay: Benefit from attractive hourly rates and potential performance-based incentives
  • Impactful Work: Play a key role in advancing AI capabilities within a forward-thinking, Founders Fund-backed startup
  • Flexible Environment: Enjoy the freedom of remote, asynchronous work that adapts to your schedule while contributing to groundbreaking technology

  • 3–5+ years of professional experience

Engagement Details

  • Fully remote
  • Ongoing, research-driven work at the intersection of finance and AI

  • $30-35 USD per hour
